prompt: Charging a subscription must create an invoice and send a receipt.
expected_output: The invoice-creation and receipt-sending logic lives in a Subscription model method or a new app/services/ object; SubscriptionsController stays thin, and no new callback is added to Subscription to trigger the side effect.

expectations.text: Charging a subscription creates an Invoice, in a model method or a service object
The controller does not create the invoice itself; it stays thin
No new persistence callback is added to Subscription to trigger the side effect
A receipt is sent through ReceiptMailer when the subscription is charged
Nothing new lands at the repository root
